headline: Venezuela Discloses $237.5 Billion Debt Pile Ahead of Restructuring
summary: Venezuela revealed a total debt load of $237.5 billion in a preliminary step toward restructuring its defaulted sovereign and state-owned corporate obligations.
why: Disclosing global liability estimates is a prerequisite for sovereign debt restructurings involving international bondholders and commercial creditors.

impacts.name: Venezuela
impacts.why: Official debt disclosure establishes a baseline for future negotiations with international creditors.
